notes.title: Patch Update (7/1/2023)
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

- Tutorial Adjustment:
Players can now progress through the Block Tutorial without camera shake.

- Arena:
Shock sound effect will no longer play if the player dies before shock hazard begins.

- Tooltips:
Tooltips will now show the custom keybind set by the player if a custom keybind has been set.

- Quality Update:
Windows taskbar now shows correct NEONSCAPE logo when game is being played.

Thank you for your support and feedback! We hope you enjoy these updates
